The world is a hostile place. Enemies increase in strength the further away from the world spawn you travel,

It is wise to explore areas close to your initial spawn to acquire loot before venturing out to face tougher enemies.

Higher level enemies yield more experience and at extreme levels will drop rare items.

You will encounter many powerful enemies throughout your journey,You should however be especially careful of these foes:

Infernal enemies are creatures spontaneously empowered by magic from the fallen realm. This can occur at random to any hostile mob granting them increased stats and special effects.These formidable foes can be spotted by the purple particles they emit.

Dungeon Masters are powerful enemies who can often be found guarding chests in dungeons. In order to access these chests they will need to be defeated.

Apothic bosses are powerful enemies who drop arcane loot when killed. A special sound and notification is given to the player when one spawns nearby.

There are many ways to increase your strength but the primary ways are the following:

Your skill tree will allow you to convert experience gained from killing monsters into skill points to spend on valuable passive bonuses.
Default key (o).

Gems are rare items which can be found all over the world at different qualities and grant powerful bonuses when socketed into your gear. Most gear you obtain will not have sockets by default and those will need to be added at a reforging table.

Enchantments can be applied to your gear at the enchanting table and will also increase your strength drastically.The enchanting table can be configured in many ways to obtain very powerful enchantments.

Champion Coins are a valuable resource gained from completing quests and other endgame activities.

These coins can be traded in the "Cisco's Wares " section of the quest book for valuable items to aid you in your journey.

Many origins despite placing light restrictions on your diet will allow you to eat a wide array of prepared meals.

Foods are granted a diversity score and you will gain powerful buffs based on your total score. Be sure to try many different foods to increase your score.

You are able to track your diversity score and foods eaten within the food book default key (.) .

During the age of heroes gods created powerful artifacts to aid mortals . However the mortals gained such immense power that the gods themselves became weary.

A mysterious primordial deity known as "the Dark One" sacrificed a small portion of his immense power to lay a curse upon these artifacts so that only those willing to undergo great sacrifice may wield them.

You possess the same dark power as i which will one day allow you to wear my equipment.

The Dark One fears that which sturs within you and will make your journey harder at certain points:

Trial 1 :  Begins at the start of your journey increasing enemy cohesion , lethality in addition the possibility of a blood moon.

Trial 2 : Begins upon entering another dimension further increasing the strength of enemies but also the rewards gained from defeating them.

Trial 3 : Begins upon slaying the ender dragon where enemies are even more merciless granting the chance of elite enemies appearing.

I sense a familiar power within you. You may be able to aid me in my quest to defeat the fell king.

Take these items and begin the journey to increase your strength. 

I will approach you when i feel you are ready.

Socketing gems into your equipment will boost the respective power of that magical school.

The main way to find these gems would be within dungeons throughout
the world.

Ambient magic resides within the world and it's living creatures. For millenia individuals have devoted their lives to it's study , separating the mana types into "schools".

Schools such as the widely used fire , ice and holy are encouraged for use by the grand citadel which oversees magical affairs. However, while not prohibited completely the use of schools such as ender are frowned upon due to the the dark nature of it's mana.

And though even those schools which have restrictions placed on their use are still widely used in some regions there are two schools which are completely forbidden.

One of the two forbidden schools eldritch, it's mana originated from the dark one himself as a gift to those whom he chose to do his bidding.

Unlike the other schools which derive their mana from the environment an individual is imbued with eldritch mana upon the acceptance of the dark one's pact.

Whilst eldritch spells are formidable on thier own thier potency can be further enhanced with the use of gems.

The dark one's gem when socketed in your gear will bolster the power of your eldritch spells.

To start your kingdom you will need supplies. 

Build and place either a supply camp or supply ship .
Whilst simple to craft the build tool will be instrumental in the correct placement of buildings and crucial for certain crafting recipes.
The town hall will be the centerpiece for your kingdom where you may view stats concerning your citizens appoint freinds as officers and manage other important affairs.
Build and place the town hall

Place the town hall block with the build tool and interact with it to start your kingdom.

You may also change the style of your kingdom during this process.

Before you can build anything you must have a builder construct the builder's hut.

Fulfill thier requests for resources while they construct the building.
The restaurant is an important building used to automatically provide food for your citizens.
The warehouse provides a place to store and manage resources generated by the kingdom.
The couriers hut is the base of the courier whom is responsible for gathering and storing excess resources in the warehouse whilst also delivering resources to citizens that request them.

The mine will provide a place for the miner to gather resources such as stone diamonds etc.

You may choose between three guard classes the tanky knight, ranged archer and supportive druid.
The university is the building from which you will research more advanced buildings for your kingdom such as the barracks or hospital.
The farm is another way of generating food for your citizens through plant based methods.
The tavern will provide temporary housing for your citizens while also providing an avenue to recruit new citizens .

The crown was originally designed by the Lawbringers as a tool to punish defiant gods. It would would vicously rend all pleasant memories from the victim's psyche then incinerate them in a streak of purple flame. As you could imagine prolonged exposure to the device's effect would break even the most resolute of minds.

However, some masochistic gods would somehow derive a twisted pleasure from it's use, later replicating the device for thier own personal pleasure.

The power contained within was at first too much for me but with deep meditation and considerable focus i learned to control and even amplify it with my own strength.

I needed a powerful weapon and so i travelled to the depths of hell in a bid to find the most resilent material known to humanity at the time.

With it i fashioned a blade decorating it with softer more ornate metals.
I inserted the gem and the blade lit up before me. Enemies hit with it were torched by dragonfire.

My friend and legendary blacksmith arthas, whilst maintaining the  blade thought it would be more efficient to use it as a lighter variant of the original. This modification would allow for faster more agile attacks . 

Reluctant , i allowed him to make his modifications upon the assurance that he would return it to its original state if need be.

An unforseen enemy....my brothers and sisters in the heavens slain.. at the brink of death, through sheer rage, my true power finally awakened.

I felt the hold of something sinister, but also a strength far beyond anything i had felt before. I reluctantly surrendered to it's cold embrace. Tainted but reborn,  i vowed to avenge the lost.

I cut my way through what felt like thousands of the Fell King's forces. My strength however, only increased with each swing of Nightfall.

Perhaps he grew tired of his legion's incompetence or thought it best to put an end to me himself but the fell king would descend upon me with a determined ferocity. After hours of furious fighting I stood atop his defeated body.

I enhanced and refined the gem untill the power within overflowed so vigourously i thought the gem would consume itself. 

With the gem now stable it was finally ready to serve it's purpose.

I knelt down and lifted the fell king's helm revealing not the face of a demon but the bloodied grin of Arthas...the blacksmith ... one whom i had considered a close freind.

He lifted his arm slowly....there was a brief pause before a sudden searing pain reverberated in my chest completely paralysing me. I could see streaks of a dark energy leaving my body being transfered to him. The colour slowly returned to his face as he got back up to his feet.

Severely weakened i struggled to get to my feet.. But a vicious strike from Fell Ragnarok would shatter my chestplate and send me flying off a nearby cliff edge.

As i plunged into the depths i could see his once familiar face staring down at me his eyes blazing with dark energy and utter contempt as he slowly turned his back , walking away, leaving me to my fate.

I used the last portion of my power to teleport myself to the end dimension averting impending doom. There the enderdragon embraced me as her kin whilst i recuperated .

I lack the power to defeat the fell king alone but perhaps you can... I wish to test your strength and should you be able to defeat me, i will show you how to summon the fell king so we can end him once and for all. 

Craft and use the talisman of challenge and we shall begin your trial.

During my journey to the fallen realm in search of a way to defeat the Fell King i stumbled upon his soldiers mining a mysterious dark crystal. Upon thorough examination it dawned on me that it was indeed the source of his immense power.

After many experiments i was able to tamper with the unique magical signature to create a weakening effect. 

Craft an altar to use as a gateway then corrupt the talisman with the fell fragments. The altar will extract his primordial essence when he is defeated.

Use the corrupted talisman on the altar and defeat the Fell king and take your rightful place as divinity.

The son of a farmerwoman and an unknown god i grew up being no stronger than the average mortal. Despite this my half brothers and sisters in the heavens always looked favourably upon me intervening at key points in my life.

What i did have however, was a natural apptitude for things arcane. So , the minute i was of age i left my small village to enroll with the order of the owl at the grand citadel. 

There i would relatively quickly attain the prestigous rank of Sage. I would eventually grow bored of the citadel however, deciding to embark on a journey to truly make a name for myself. Using my knowledge of alchemy i forged a ruby that would be help me borrow and harness the divine gifts of my more powerful kin to aid me on what would surely be a treachorous journey.

The lawbringers were a race of mysterious celestial beings whose purpose was to cast judgment on gods found guilty of committing crimes they deemed "unforgivables".

One such crime was ressurecting the dead. Pollux was found guilty of this when he brought his twin brother back from death and as punishement the pair were sealed into two seperate blades.

The thunder god gifted this blade to a brave warrior tasked with guarding the gate to the thunder isles.

He once used it to turn a field full of invading enemies to a field full of ash.

The wind diety blesed this armor and gifted it to the first settlers of her nation, Since then it has been used by the sovereign monarchy of the land of wind under it's ruler titled "Ventus Supremi". 

A great prince wearing this armor once shattered an enemy detachment which such ferocity and speed that the survivors reported being attacked by a hurricane.

A legendary spear which contains powerful wind magic. Noone knows its true origin or the purpose for it's creation.

However scholars speculate that it may have been forged in the land of wind and has since been lost to time.
These twin daggers carry the souls of brothers with an unbreakable bond.

Some believe that this weapon originated from the ice god and her descendants conquered and ruled over the ice tribes using it's power.

The first fell king is also rumored to be a member of the ice tribe.

The first ascended hero Cisco. Fought with an unamed hero to defeat the the first fell king Arthas .

His power was passed down through his descendants who would later fight against the descendants of the fell king.

500 years after the events of the first fell king war the second fell king Bjorn attacked and nearly annilated the fire kingdom. 

In this Era Princess Carmilla of that nation inherited her ancestor cisco's power and become the second ascended hero defeating and pushing back the fell forces.

Another 250 years elapsed untill the third fell king Sylvi arose once more, this time with the intent of conquest rather than complete destruction. She for the most part succeded merging the ice , thunder and shrouded nations into one large empire.

The fire kingdom allied with the wind and holy nations to combat the opposing threat. In this Era Arthur a knight of the fire kingdom inherited his ancestor's power becoming the third ascended hero. After years of ceaseless fighting he approached Sylvi with an offer.

For the rest of her lifetime there would be peace and in return he would marry her thus merging the bloodlines of the first fell king and cisco ensuring that thier descendants would eventually have the power and standing to unite all the kingdoms into one.

To assess one's magical ability the order of the owl would have thier initiates attune a magical stone to the location of thier assigned dorm.

Those who failed to do this within the alloted time frame and were lucky would be considered talentless and expelled from the order without exception.

The unlucky however...would either teleport within a wall, a hungry creature's den, or meet some other very unfortunate end.

This ornate ring was gifted to all members of the order of the owl who could attain the rank of sage. 

This could be achieved only by ascending the ranks to mage knight adept then acquiring complete mastery over any one of the many fields of magic.

To signify that mastery they would need to create a unique new spell based in that field to add to the grand repository.

When a cult of fanatic mages within the ice nation accidentally released the fell forces upon the world they could do nothing to stop the massacre which followed.

Bjorn a general serving under the ruling tribe proposed a request for aid with the only nation with which they had a good relationship, the fire kingdom.

The fire kingdom however refused seeing the issue as just punishement for thier foolishness. With the royal family slain the very mages responsible for the calamity proposed a solution.

A ritual to send the strongest warrior still breathing to the fallen realm in hopes of obtaining the power neccesary to stop the fellforces. They cast the spell on bjorn transporting him to the realm of the fallen.

Years passed for him but in only moments he returned clad in demonium armor only able to eirily utter one word "Revenge". The fell forces cowered in his presence and with thier strength he would launch a campaign to destroy everything starting with the fire kingdom.

Princess sylvi of the ruling ice tribe was renowned as a fierce warrior but best known for her remarkable intellect and aptitude for battle strategy.

When her father was killed in battle she fully expected to ascend the throne. Her uncle ragnar however had other plans and at the conclave opposed her rule gaining support from majority of the ice tribes.

As a result sylvi was forced into exile. What exactly happened during that period was unknown but when she returned an army of fell legionaires marched behind her.

She would decimate her uncles forces and personally send him to niflheim. After putting the rest of the traitorous leaders to the sword and reclaiming her birthright she would set her sights on the neighbouring kingdoms. 

When it was proposed to her that she be called "Fell Queen" she refused insisting that the mantle of "Fell King" be used instead to honor those that came before her.

Shortly after her 16th burdr-dagr sylvi entered her first battle against a neighbouring tribe . As one by one the members of her personal body guard unit fell, she fought on ferociously seemingly getting stronger as the battle raged on. 

Though the victory came at a heavy cost ,her father King Ivar desired to reward her bravery and thus had a pristine blade forged and enchanted as a gift to his heir apparent.

"A blade that will grow in strength to match your will " he said as he placed it into her hands. She would use this blade to claim her birthright bringing it down upon her traitourous uncle ragnar's neck ending the conflict of succession.

Bjorn emerged from the fallen realm a fractured shell of his former self. Despite his new found power whatever that was left of his mind seemed to be locked in a pernicious grip by an unholy entity.

He emerged from the portal wielding Hellbrand, a peculilar weapon seemingly a conduit for the dark presense. It whispered to him tales of glorious destruction whilst remaining ever vigilant for those who would seek to betray, the newly crowned Fell King.

Centuries after the death of Cisco we would see the rise of Alexander his descendant, the verdant ascendant and heir to unified bloodlines of light and fell.

He possesed and unmathced command over time and gravity and would go on to unify the known kingdoms  into a singular empire later being crowned the sovereign ascendant.

*Arthas approaches you with an offer .* Cisco is but a foolish half breed born of tainted blood. Look at you his prized pupil forged in his image yet bound needlessly by his chains.

Do you truly believe that Cisco's power was ever truly yours to share? The true power he keeps for himself while cautioning you to excercise balance and restraint.  

But i see that blazing hunger flickering behind your loyalty. Join me and together will we strike down the false hero . We wont kneel before the gods that toyed with him nor cower before the legacy he clings to. 

Together we will claim that precious spark of divinity he posseses and wield it as we see fit.

So you have chosen the shadows over your would be saviour....good. 

Despite his shortcomings Cisco is not to be underestimated. Summoning him with the intent of betrayal without weakining him first would  be a grave blunder. 

Gather fell fragments and nocturnal amethyst then twist the talisman of challenge to gain the upper hand.

The moment has come little betrayer.

The talisman of challenge once a relic forged in trust and used for your freindly duel will carry your treachery straight to his heart.
